task.title: To Rotate OnCallLists
task.shortdesc: You can manually rotate the OnCallLists using the Rotate button. When you rotate the list, you change its priority order. Each user in the list moves down to the next configured priority level, and the system moves the user with the lowest priority back up to the highest priority.

step.cmd: Use one of the following methods to rotate the OnCallList:

choices.choice: Navigate to On Call List Manager view and double-click any one of the existing OnCallList. The On Call Contact Manager view opens. Click. Rotate.
Navigate to On Call Contact Manager view, select any one of the OnCallList from the existing list, and click Rotate button.

step.stepresult: You can see the list of the priority changes.
